A chronological account of the Thargoid War: its opening incursions, major fleet actions, the Titans, human/Guardian counter-technology, and its eventual resolution — covering what happened and when, for readers who want the history rather than current-play instructions. Current Thargoid gameplay mechanics (combat, technology, materials) belong on [[Thargoid]] instead; this page is specifically the historical timeline.
